misc: Adopted a L.A.B. Golf zero torque putter for the 2025 season
biography: Simo, representing the distinguished Hirsala Golf, is a veteran presence within the competitive framework of the Hector Trophée. As the upcoming 2026 edition approaches, it will mark his eleventh participation in this esteemed event, a testament to his sustained commitment and long-standing engagement with the tournament's unique format.

Throughout his ten previous appearances, Simo has demonstrated an undeniable aptitude for the pair competition, having been a central figure in three victorious duos who have hoisted the coveted Hector Trophée. This impressive record in the team format solidifies his reputation as a highly effective partner, capable of elevating his pair's performance under pressure. While the individual Victor Trophy has, to date, eluded his grasp, his significant contributions to the collective success are prominently etched into the tournament's history.

Known for an exceptionally expressive demeanor on the course, Simo’s passion for the game is often manifest through his candid reactions, a characteristic that adds a unique dynamic to his presence. His ongoing dedication to refining his play was underscored in 2025, when he strategically adopted a L.A.B. Golf zero torque putter, an adjustment signaling his relentless pursuit of precision on the greens.

As Simo prepares for his eleventh foray into the Hector Trophée, observers anticipate another compelling performance from this seasoned competitor. His proven capacity for teamwork and his unwavering determination continue to make him a noteworthy participant, eager to add further chapters to his already decorated history in the event.
